*** THIRD DAY ON THE DECEMBER BRENT CONTRACT — STILL NOT COMPARABLE BACKWARDS ***
@LCO.1 remains Dec'26. Its prev of 102.31 is December's Thursday settle and matches CNBC's own market
report exactly, so today's -0.77% is a true like-for-like move. But Wednesday evening's published 103.62
was the NOVEMBER contract, so anyone comparing this week's editions across the roll still sees a fall
that is partly mechanical. The Brent driver says so for the third edition running, per the standing rule.

not ingested Thursday's actual close. On that stale figure today's move would be -0.028.

DECISION: publish the ten-year at 5.37 with a change of -0.02. The level is CNBC's live 5.3744 rounded;

published last night: 5.39 - 0.02 = 5.37. The week's published series is therefore coherent throughout:
